import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Step 1: Group by RespAgeSimple and SessionId, count unique JourneyIds
journey_counts = (
  df.groupby(["RespAgeSimple", "SessionId"])["JourneyId"]
  .nunique()
  .reset_index(name="NumJourneys")
)

# Step 2: Sum journeys per age group (across all sessions)
age_journey_summary = journey_counts.groupby("RespAgeSimple")["NumJourneys"].sum().reset_index()

# Step 3: Ensure RespAgeSimple is a categorical variable with correct order
sorted_ages = sorted(age_journey_summary["RespAgeSimple"].dropna().unique())
age_journey_summary["RespAgeSimple"] = pd.Categorical(age_journey_summary["RespAgeSimple"], 
                                                      categories=sorted_ages,
                                                      ordered=True)

# Step 4: Define tick labels (every 2 years)
custom_ticks = list(range(18,85,2))

# Step 5: Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
sns.barplot(data=age_journey_summary, x="RespAgeSimple", y="NumJourneys", color="#4C72B0")

# Set custom ticks — match ticks to x-axis labels
plt.xticks(
    ticks=[i for i, age in enumerate(sorted_ages) if age in custom_ticks],
    labels=[age for age in sorted_ages if age in custom_ticks],
    rotation=0
)

younger/older sibling in hh

#Whether ther's a younger/older sibling presents in HH
df['10to17_hh'] = df['AgeSimple'].apply(
    lambda x: 1 if 9 < x < 18 else 0
)

df['0to9_hh'] = df['AgeSimple'].apply(
    lambda x: 1 if 0 <= x <= 9 else 0
)

#The number of younger/older sibling in HH

# Step 1: Recalculate number of children per age group in household
df["Num_0_9"] = df["HousehNumPers"] - df["HousehNumPers1084"]
households_with_85plus = df[df["AgeSimple"] >= 85]["SessionId"].unique()
df.loc[df["SessionId"].isin(households_with_85plus), "Num_0_9"] = np.nan

df["Num_0_17"] = df["HousehNumPers"] - df["HousehNumAdults"]
df["Num_10_17"] = df["Num_0_17"] - df["Num_0_9"]
df.loc[df["Num_10_17"] < 0, "Num_10_17"] = np.nan
df = df.dropna(subset=["Num_10_17"])

# Step 2: Get one row per household
household_df = df.drop_duplicates("SessionId")[["SessionId", "Num_0_9", "Num_10_17"]].copy()

n09 = household_df["Num_0_9"].fillna(0)
n1017 = household_df["Num_10_17"].fillna(0)

# Step 3: Create binary indicators
household_df["ChildinHH_017"] = ((n09 > 0) & (n1017 > 0)).astype(int)
household_df["ChildinHH_09"] = ((n09 > 0) & (n1017 == 0)).astype(int)
household_df["ChildinHH_1017"] = ((n09 == 0) & (n1017 > 0)).astype(int)
household_df["ChildinHH_None"] = ((n09 == 0) & (n1017 == 0)).astype(int)

# Optional: merge back if needed
df = df.merge(
    household_df[["SessionId", "ChildinHH_017", "ChildinHH_09", "ChildinHH_1017", "ChildinHH_None"]],
    on="SessionId",
    how="left"
)

df = df[df["ChildinHH_None"] == 0]
counts = df.groupby('10to17_hh')['SessionId'].nunique()
percentages1 = counts / counts.sum() * 100

counts = df.groupby('0to9_hh')['SessionId'].nunique()
percentages2 = counts / counts.sum() * 100

counts = df.groupby('ChildinHH_017')['SessionId'].nunique()
percentages3 = counts / counts.sum() * 100

counts = df.groupby('ChildinHH_09')['SessionId'].nunique()
percentages4 = counts / counts.sum() * 100

counts = df.groupby('ChildinHH_1017')['SessionId'].nunique()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

categories = df["PrimTargetPurp_Cat"].unique()

for cat in categories:
    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
    subset = df[df["PrimTargetPurp_Cat"] == cat]
    
    sns.histplot(subset["TravelTimeMinutes"].dropna(), bins=30, kde=False)
    plt.title(f"Distribution of Journey Duration for each Purpose: {cat}")
    plt.xlabel("Journey Duration (minutes)")
    plt.ylabel("Count")
    plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
    plt.show()

          '450-500', '500-550', '550-600', '600-650', '650-700', '700-750', '750-800', '800-850', '850-900', '900-950', '950p']
